summary.text: Furious Red Heart Flames is an immortal killer move Fire Plain Grotto Lord uses when Fang Yuan ambushes him.

claims.text: Fang Yuan traps Fire Plain Grotto Lord in a battlefield killer move in immemorial white heaven and tells him to hand over his Immortal Gu and Fire Plain grotto-heaven. Fire Plain Grotto Lord says he is not Fang Yuan’s match and asks to consider the request. Blazing flames then burn around his body with a loud sound. Within the fire he shouts at Fang Yuan not to force him. He threatens to burn all of the Gu worms and resources in his immortal aperture with one thought. He asks Fang Yuan to let him leave the battlefield, and he will hand his Gu worms over. He tries to use this threat to survive. Fang Yuan snorts that he does not care about those few Immortal Gu or the resources in the immortal aperture, and tells him to go ahead and burn, even to incinerate the entire immortal aperture. Fang Yuan vanishes into the blue fog. Blue eyed children jump out and attack continuously. After a few breaths Fire Plain Grotto Lord growls in anger as the flames explode around him, and he burns himself to a crisp.

Fire Plain true inheritance holds a profound method called furious red heart flames. Fire Plain Grotto Lord used it before his death to threaten Fang Yuan to let him off, and it was used in his suicide.
